_comment: Clayworks LITE — full example. Three hooks wired: UserPromptSubmit (Nudge), SessionStart (primer + git warn), Stop (turn log). Companion files in examples/full/hooks/ should be copied to ~/.claude/hooks/. Merge into ~/.claude/settings.json; append, do not replace existing hooks arrays.

hooks._comment: Nudge: surfaces due alerts as system-reminders
Primer surface + uncommitted-git warning. See examples/full/hooks/sessionstart.sh.
Per-turn end-time logging. Extend with a 24h-gated background trigger for dream-style consolidation if you want; see hooks/examples/stop.sh in the LITE repo for the gating skeleton.
